name: Link

props.note: Same name. Figma holds text only.
Same name and default. Shows the external-link icon.
Web only. Lets the link render as a router component.
Figma-only axis. focus is :focus-visible. Code also has a visited state, which Figma does not draw.

purpose: Navigates to another page, screen, section or external URL. Underlined so it is identifiable without color.

props.name: href
props.description: Destination. On native, opened with Linking.openURL unless onPress is given.

props.name: children
props.description: Link text. Must describe the destination ('View bracket', not 'Click here').

props.name: variant
props.description: inline in prose; standalone on its own line with a chevron; subtle for low-emphasis meta links.

props.name: external
props.description: Opens a new tab/browser, adds rel=noopener noreferrer, an external icon and an SR hint.

props.name: as
props.description: Router link component (Next.js Link, React Router Link). Must render an <a>.

props.name: onPress
props.description: In-app navigation handler (e.g. router.push). Overrides href.

screenReader: External links append '(opens in a new tab)'.
accessibility.touchTarget: Inline links in prose are exempt from target size; standalone links should have ≥44px line height on touch.
notes: Always warn users when a link opens a new window (IBM 3.2.5 / G201).

variants.name: inline
variants.useWhen: Links inside paragraphs and help text.

variants.name: standalone
variants.description: Bolder, no underline until hover, trailing chevron.
variants.useWhen: 'View all matches' at the end of a card.

do: Write link text that makes sense out of context.
Use Link for anything that changes the URL or screen.
dont: Don't use 'click here' or 'read more' without context.
Don't style a Link like a Button for in-page actions; use Button.
Don't remove the underline from inline links.

related.name: Tabs
related.reason: Switching views within the same page.

example.web:
Read the tournament rules before registering.

Official rules View brackets
example.native:
<Link href="https://fifa.com" external>Official rules</Link>
<Link href="/brackets" variant="standalone" onPress={() => router.push('/brackets')}>View brackets</Link>
